title: Forged in the Dark Faction (third-party content)
description: Frontmatter contract for a Forged-in-the-Dark faction. Maps to a Sled Dog World organization entry (name/description/notes/relations columns + a rich `details` payload). Write from the Blades in the Dark SRD vocabulary; use no Duskwall setting text, NPCs, art, or maps.

slug.description: kebab-case, no leading 'the-'. Sled Dog namespaces it (e.g. ext:<author>:<slug>).

summary.description: One-line hook shown on the crew's Manage content page.

description.description: Who They Are — what the faction is, how it operates, its sign.

tier.description: Faction tier 0–6 (their reach, wealth, and hold on their turf).

hold.description: Whether their hold on their tier is strong or weak.

turf.description: The territory, market, or racket they control.

background.description: One paragraph: how the faction came to be; keep one thing hidden.

goals.description: What they are working to bring about.

faultLine.description: The internal split or vulnerability that could break them.

notables.description: Notable members (name + a line on their role).

relations.description: Ties & Relationships — loaded prompts addressed to the crew.

clocks.description: Faction project/war clocks the GM can advance.

hooks.description: Reasons the faction pulls a crew into motion.

images.description: Optional images shipped to the party image gallery when this module is installed (a supporter feature). Files live beside this .md in the content repo; Sled Dog serves them from GitHub raw, pinned to the content commit.

file.description: Path to the image relative to this module folder (e.g. "art/homefront.png"). No leading slash, no "..".

caption.description: Short title shown on the gallery card.

description.description: Longer notes shown when the card is expanded.

url.description: A published Supabase public URL (paid packs). Alternative to `file`.

pack.description: For paid-pack content only: the pack slug this item belongs to.

note.description: Their role/epithet and what they're about.
